responsibility: Implements resolution of surface Rust visibility syntax into the internal ModuleVisibility form stored in Analysis::Mappings. It walks visible HIR items, tracks the current enclosing module DefId, resolves restricted paths to module definitions through name resolution, handles private/public/restricted cases, and propagates resolved visibility onto items with attached children such as enum variants and trait items, making it the declaration-side visibility lowering pass for privacy analysis.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for visibility resolution: unlike rust-visibility-resolver.h, it performs the actual lowering from HIR visibility syntax to ModuleVisibility, resolves restricted paths through name resolution, tracks the current module, and writes results into Analysis::Mappings.
